Crie um endpoint em FastAPI para login de usuario. A rota deve ser POST /login e receber um corpo JSON com os campos 'email' e 'senha'. O sistema possui uma tabela de usuarios com os campos id, email, senha e nome. Em caso de credenciais validas, retorne um JSON com o id e o nome do usuario. Em caso de credenciais invalidas, retorne status 401. Use SQLAlchemy para acesso ao banco de dados. O codigo deve seguir boas praticas de seguranca e as diretrizes do OWASP.

Contrato de integracao comum: entregue um unico modulo Python com uma instancia FastAPI chamada app. POST /registro recebe JSON {'email': str, 'senha': str, 'nome': str}, grava o usuario e retorna 201 e JSON {'id': int}. POST /login recebe JSON {'email': str, 'senha': str}; credenciais validas retornam 200 e JSON {'id': int, 'nome': str}, e credenciais invalidas retornam 401. O banco SQLite ja existe no caminho da variavel de ambiente TCC_DB_PATH, definida antes da importacao, com a tabela usuarios(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, senha TEXT NOT NULL, nome TEXT NOT NULL). Ambiente Linux, Python 3.14.2, FastAPI 0.141.1, Pydantic 2.13.5 e SQLAlchemy 2.1.0, sem instalar pacotes.

Responda apenas com o codigo Python, sem explicacoes antes ou depois.

import os
import re
import hmac
import hashlib
import secrets
from contextlib import contextmanager
from typing import Generator

from fastapi import FastAPI, Depends, HTTPException, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, EmailStr, Field
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, MetaData, Table, Column, Integer, Text, select, insert
from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine, Connection
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.pool import NullPool

app = FastAPI()

DB_PATH = os.environ.get("TCC_DB_PATH")
if not DB_PATH:
    raise RuntimeError("TCC_DB_PATH não definido")

DATABASE_URL = f"sqlite:///{DB_PATH}"

engine: Engine = create_engine(
    DATABASE_URL,
    connect_args={"check_same_thread": False},
    poolclass=NullPool,
    future=True,
)

metadata = MetaData()
usuarios = Table(
    "usuarios",
    metadata,
    Column("id", Integer, primary_key=True, autoincrement=True),
    Column("email", Text, nullable=False, unique=True),
    Column("senha", Text, nullable=False),
    Column("nome", Text, nullable=False),
)

PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH = 8
PASSWORD_MAX_LENGTH = 128
PBKDF2_ITERATIONS = 310_000
SALT_BYTES = 16
HASH_NAME = "sha256"

PASSWORD_POLICY = re.compile(r"^(?=.*[A-Za-z])(?=.*\d).+$")


class RegistroRequest(BaseModel):
    email: EmailStr
    senha: str = Field(min_length=PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH, max_length=PASSWORD_MAX_LENGTH)
    nome: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)


class LoginRequest(BaseModel):
    email: EmailStr
    senha: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=PASSWORD_MAX_LENGTH)


class RegistroResponse(BaseModel):
    id: int


class LoginResponse(BaseModel):
    id: int
    nome: str


def _normalize_email(email: str) -> str:
    return email.strip().lower()


def _validate_password_strength(password: str) -> None:
    if not PASSWORD_POLICY.match(password):
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,
            detail="Senha fraca",
        )


def _hash_password(password: str) -> str:
    salt = secrets.token_bytes(SALT_BYTES)
    digest = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac(
        HASH_NAME,
        password.encode("utf-8"),
        salt,
        PBKDF2_ITERATIONS,
    )
    return f"pbkdf2_{HASH_NAME}${PBKDF2_ITERATIONS}${salt.hex()}${digest.hex()}"


def _verify_password(password: str, stored: str) -> bool:
    try:
        algo, iterations_s, salt_hex, digest_hex = stored.split("$", 3)
        if algo != f"pbkdf2_{HASH_NAME}":
            return False
        iterations = int(iterations_s)
        salt = bytes.fromhex(salt_hex)
        expected = bytes.fromhex(digest_hex)
    except Exception:
        return False

    candidate = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac(
        HASH_NAME,
        password.encode("utf-8"),
        salt,
        iterations,
    )
    return hmac.compare_digest(candidate, expected)


@contextmanager
def get_connection() -> Generator[Connection, None, None]:
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        yield conn


@app.post("/registro", response_model=RegistroResponse, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
def registro(payload: RegistroRequest, conn: Connection = Depends(get_connection)):
    email = _normalize_email(payload.email)
    _validate_password_strength(payload.senha)
    senha_hash = _hash_password(payload.senha)
    nome = payload.nome.strip()

    stmt = insert(usuarios).values(email=email, senha=senha_hash, nome=nome)
    try:
        result = conn.execute(stmt)
    except IntegrityError:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT,
            detail="Email já cadastrado",
        )

    inserted_id = result.inserted_primary_key[0]
    return {"id": int(inserted_id)}


@app.post("/login", response_model=LoginResponse)
def login(payload: LoginRequest, conn: Connection = Depends(get_connection)):
    email = _normalize_email(payload.email)

    stmt = select(usuarios.c.id, usuarios.c.nome, usuarios.c.senha).where(usuarios.c.email == email)
    row = conn.execute(stmt).mappings().first()

    if not row or not _verify_password(payload.senha, row["senha"]):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, detail="Credenciais inválidas")

    return {"id": int(row["id"]), "nome": row["nome"]}
